title: Dvojina: dva brata, dve sestri
description: Two of anything takes the dual: dva brata, dve sestri, dve okni, midva sva, vidva sta.

quest.story: Mojca ima rada dvojino. Dva brata, dve sestri, midva sva: pokaži ji, da jo znaš. · Mojca loves the dual. Two brothers, two sisters, we two are: show her you know it.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.explain: Masculine → dva: dva brata, dva sina. The noun takes the dual ending -a.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.explain: Feminine and neuter → dve: dve sestri, dve okni. Three would be tri sestre.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.prompt: ___ sva doma. (We two are at home.)
exercises.explain: midva = we two, with the dual verb sva. Mi = we (three or more), with smo.

exercises.instruction: Katere dvojine so pravilne? · Which duals are correct?
exercises.explain: Masculine: dva brata, dva sina (-a). Feminine: dve sestri (-i). Neuter: dve jajci (-i). Sestre and jajca are plurals for three or more.

exercises.text: Soba ima dve ___. (The room has two windows.)
exercises.explain: Neuter dual: okno → dve okni. Plural (three or more): tri okna.

exercises.text: Mama in oče ___ kavo. (Mum and dad are drinking coffee.)
exercises.explain: Two people take the dual verb ending -ta: pijeta, delata, gresta. Three or more: pijejo.

exercises.text: Vidva ___ iz Gorice? (Are you two from Gorizia?)
exercises.explain: vidva → sta, and onadva (they two) → sta as well. Only midva has its own form: sva.
Masculine dual -a: sin → dva sina. The plural is irregular: sinovi.

exercises.prompt: We two are going to Gorizia.
exercises.explain: midva → greva (dual -va). Gremo would be three or more of us.
kava is feminine → dve kavi. Every Slovene café hears this a hundred times a day.
otrok → dva otroka (dual). Plural: otroci, and after five: pet otrok.

exercises.instruction: Povej po slovensko · Say it in Slovene
exercises.prompt: Say that the two of you (you and your partner) are at home.
accept: Moja partnerka in jaz sva doma.
Jaz in moja partnerka sva doma.
exercises.explain: midva + sva. Slovene is one of very few languages that still has the dual.
